blocking_findings: The J363-A1 receipt reports only 70% touch-target compliance and 38% WCAG AA contrast compliance.
The runner can report PASS while accessibility requirements fail, performance is absent and 768px is untested.
Rendered factual claims lack a stable claim-to-source/hash/validity mapping in the receipt.
required_actions: Bring every interactive control to at least 44x44 CSS px across 1440, 768 and 390 viewports. Count all controls that can receive a pointer/touch action; document explicit excluded noninteractive text.

Repair every relevant foreground/background state to WCAG 2.1 AA: at least 4.5:1 normal text and 3:1 large text/UI boundaries. Measure default, hover, focus, disabled and modal states; report each failure rather than averaging. AAA is aspirational and must be reported separately.
Extend the runner to test 1440, 768 and 390, and fail overall status for any console/page error, overflow, touch-target failure, AA failure, missing module assertion or unavailable Preview response.

Measure representative interaction frame timing and layout shift for the stack calculator, campus filter, lunch slider, Split Bill export and affiliate dry-run. Write measured p50/p95/max frame duration and CLS/shift observations to receipt. Do not claim 60 FPS or CLS=0 when not measured.

Create a J363 claim matrix mapping each factual meal, cinema scenario, DanaBus fare and education benefit to source URL, capture time, raw/screenshot hash, locality/eligibility, validity or explicit simulation state. Claims without support must remain simulation or awaiting-verification cards and must not be called verified.

Test Canvas PNG download, clipboard denial, Web Share fallback and outbound links with an actual user-gesture simulation. Verify no PII/GPS/contact request and no background network or automatic affiliate navigation.
Reissue STAGING_OBSERVABILITY_RECEIPT.json with runner hash, served preview URL/hash, full assertions, source matrix hash and a PASS only if every required gate passes.
acceptance: CEO independently replays the in-workspace runner against the served preview and confirms 100% touch target/AA compliance, 1440/768/390 coverage, measured interaction evidence and claim provenance before submitting v3.431.0 to Gemini.
